years.description: Jer as Shadow from Legend, our friend K as Auntie Whispers from Over the Garden Wall, Moxxi as Wadsworth from Clue, Lavina is Pennywise from It, Anaya is Frank N Furter from Rocky Horror Picture Show and Mordecai is Long John Silver from Muppet Treasure Island.

photos.alt: A group of people and dogs dressed as iconic Tim Curry characters stand on a suburban street in the fall.
Anaya as Frank N Furter in green surgical gown and fishnets, snapping one pink latex glove.
Jer as Shadow from Legend, laughing.
Lavina as Pennywise, holding a single red baloon.
K as Auntie Whispers with bell.
Moxxi as Wadsworth, with clue game peices attached to her back.
Mordecai as Long John Silver, complete with pet lobster and jaunty tricorn hat.

years.description: Jer and Anaya as Adam and Barbara Maitland, Lavina as their death case worker, Juno, Mordecai as Beetlejuice, and Moxxi as a sandworm.

photos.alt: Jer, Anaya, Lavina and Moxxi.
Jer holding Mordecai, Anaya holding Moxxi's leash.
Moxxi as a sandworm. This angle is better and the costume's fin and red eye are shown.

years.description: The Four Dogs of the A-PAW-Calypse. Mordecai is War, Anaya Pestilence, Jer Famine and Moxxi death.

photos.alt: Mordecai. Anaya, Jer and Moxxi pose on the street.

years.description: Anaya, Jer, Mordecai and Moxxi as a Barkershop Quartet.
Jer as the Joker, Anaya as Poison Ivy, Mordecai as the Riddler, Moxxi as Harley Quinn.

Jer holds Moxxi, Anaya Mordecai in a yard strewn with fallen leaves.

years.description: Anaya and Jer as Firefighters, Mordecai as fire.

Anaya and Jer stand before a large spiderweb. Jer is holding Mordecai.

Anaya wears a black dress over a white shirt, and her hair in pigtails. Jer wears a striped shirt.
